summary: Tested admin impersonation (read-only student view) end-to-end. 16/16 backend pytest tests pass; UI flow (Students page -> impersonate -> yellow bar + student sidebar/nav -> exit button -> logout) all pass. Backend correctly: issues 1h token with imp=admin claim, writes impersonation_logs, blocks docente/estudiante (403), rejects non-estudiante/inactive targets (400), prevents double-impersonation, surfaces impersonated_by in /auth/me, allows GET endpoints as the student, blocks any non-GET with 403 'Vista de alumno: solo lectura', allows POST /auth/logout, and invalidates the token (401) when the admin is deactivated or demoted. Regression on normal admin and student /auth/me + heartbeat verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.useEffect: initial /auth/me catch calls setUser(false) only when no admin token exists. If both tokens are stale, stopImpersonation() reloads to /estudiantes without clearing otec_token first (admin backup is restored); acceptable but worth revisit if admin token also expired.

server.impersonate: 'already impersonating' guard checks admin.get('impersonated_by'), but admin_only requires role=='admin' which an impersonation token (student role) will fail first with 403, not 400. Behaviour is correct (still rejected) but spec says 400. Low priority.
No audit log entry on stopImpersonation; only start is logged. Consider logging end for completeness.

startImpersonation stores previous admin token in localStorage even if empty; relying on cookie-only admin login would lose the admin session on exit. Current flow depends on otec_token being present.
test_credentials: Admin via JWT minted with JWT_SECRET for seeded admin info@iberoacademy.cl (OTP flow unused to avoid email).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_imp_course, TEST users (delivered+TEST_impstu/impinactive/impdoc/impadmin/impui@resend.dev) and TEST_impui_stu for UI run. All deleted at the end of tests + manual mongosh cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Impersonation feature is working on both backend and frontend. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_impersonation.py. Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_impersonation.py -n 0 (pytest.ini forces xdist -n 2 loadscope but module-scoped fixtures create duplicate users across workers; use -n 0 for this file).
